product: Madagascar Centella Hyalu-Cica Jelly-Fit Ampoule Pads

reviews.headline: Great for sensitive skin
reviews.comment: My skin hates cream moisturizer; it makes me break out.  So I was looking for non-cream products that would hydrate my skin and came across this. Purchased without knowing much about the brand or product but I'm glad I did. I use this when I need extra hydration in the morning or night. Doesn't break me out. It's calming and easy to use (comes with tongs to help remove esch pad). I don't use it daily so I still have plenty of pads left.
